card.name: Inside the word anticoagulant
card.fires_on: The "ag" piece in the middle of "anticoagulant(s)" in drug interaction text. It also fires weakly on "warfarin" and on "of" before insulin.

modes.label: anticoagulant spelling
modes.description: The "ag" piece after "antico" in anticoagulant or anticoagulants, in interaction statements.
modes.example: Phenobarbital may decrease the effect of antico<<ag>>ulants, and necessitate larger doses

modes.label: Other interaction wording
modes.description: Weaker cases on the end of warfarin or on "of" before a named drug in interaction statements.
modes.example: tinidazole may enhance the effect of warfar<<in>> and other coumarin anticoag

card.plain: It marks the middle of the word anticoagulant when a label lists drugs that interact with blood thinners.
